Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's unusual.
I wonder if someone's in it."
Touya: "Of course people use it."
Yamato: "But whenever I see it, it's stopped.
And it's always right on the floor I'm on."
Touya: "You're imagining it. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
To protect those I love, my blade of justice strikes the foe!
My crimson blood burns red! This is the way a man must live!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaariooon!!
At your service! For justice... I could die."
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Heeey!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I went to all the trouble of waiting for you..."
Touya: "...You should have Gabon take a look at you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I am the very picture of health!
I'm not so weak that I'd get sick!
Dah ha ha ha!"
Yamato: "...It's serious."
Fain: "...Well? What did you think? I'm rather proud
of this one. Ah, my own talent frightens me."
It's pretty good, isn't it?
It sounds like enka.
Fain: "Right? Especially that last part.
Even I get chills saying it."
Yamato: "He's drunk on himself... This is terminal."
Touya: "I-I see. Well, keep it up."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... You could call it 'the song
of the Japanese heart,' I guess."
Fain: "The heart? Do you mean a song
that speaks directly to the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Ohhh! So that means my introduction
is just that magnificent!"
Yamato: "Y-Yes... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dah ha ha ha! You understand!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you
so straightforward?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
To die for it would be my greatest wish!
And that justice also serves to protect those I hold dear!"
Touya: "Ohhh, those you hold dear..."
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, for Miss Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No, my justice
cannot be so fickle! Oh, what should I do...?"
Yamato: "...What should we do?"
Touya: "We'd better stay away..."
Fain: "We're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who should I fight for?
I've vowed to love only one woman.
But I have the noble, supreme
duty to protect the princess. I cannot abandon either loyalty or love.
Ah... What a trial! Such is a knight's fate!
Then I shall press on! To fight destiny itself!
No, wait. My master also said that desiring too much at once
is the same as losing everything.
Does that mean I must commit to one or the other?!
Ohhh! How can this be?!
And choosing between Miss Ymir and Kasumi...
Damn it, this is all the ≪Ze=Ode≫'s fault...
If they didn't exist, I wouldn't have to endure
such paaaain...
Ah! Could this be their conspiracy?!
Grrrrrr! Damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome the ≪Ze=Ode≫ are!!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, will not
be defeated by so little! Hm? Then does that mean
that, to turn their plan against them,
I must preserve both my love for those two
and my loyalty to the princess, all at once?
No, but that would defy my master's teachings.
Aaaaah, what am I supposed to doooo?!!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He's got his own troubles."
Touya: "Well, he seems happy enough doing that.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
Derock: "Honestly, this elevator takes forever to come.
It's so irritating... Oh."
Yamato: "Oh, Derock..."
Touya: "...What are you muttering about?"
Derock: "Oh, it's you two..."
Derock: "Oh, it's finally here.
Hm? You're not getting on?
Then I'll take it."
Yamato: "Hey! We are getting on.
Wait your turn!"
Derock: "...Tch."
Derock: "Hurry up and move to the side.
I can't get on with you standing right in the middle."
Touya: "Okay..."
Derock: "There we go."
Derock: "W-What? What's going on?"
Yamato: "It looks like we're over the weight limit."
Derock: "That's impossible. This can hold up to ten people
and twenty lot (1t)."
Yamato: "How does that work?
Those numbers make no sense."
Derock: "There are plenty of things in this world
that common sense can't explain."
Touya: "...I don't care. Just get off.
That beeping's annoying."
Derock: "Getting off won't make any difference..."
Touya: "The beeping... stopped."
Derock: "W-What are you talking about?
The malfunction just happened to fix itself when I got off.
Watch carefully. I'm getting on again."
Yamato: "We're over the weight limit after all."
Derock: "N-No, we're not. I-It's just broken!"
Touya (He really doesn't know when to give up...)
Yamato: "That beeping's annoying. Get off for a moment."
Derock: "A-All right..."
Touya: "Looks like it fixed itself at just the right moment again."
Derock: "I-I'm in a hurry.
It'll be fine if you two get off.
Hurry up and switch with me."
Yamato: "What's that supposed to mean?!"
All right.
No way.
Derock: "You're a good guy."
Touya: "But I don't think it'll make any difference if we get off..."
Derock: "O-Of course it will.
It'll be perfectly fine."
Yamato: "Go ahead."
Derock: "..."
Touya: "Oh? Looks like it's working."
Derock: "Naturally. I'll be going ahead."
Yamato: "Oh..."
Derock: "S-Somebody help me!
The elevator stopped between floors!
The lights went out, and I can't see anything.
Heeelp!"
Touya: "I knew it wouldn't work..."
Derock: "I-It's moving again.
I-I'm saved..."
Yamato: "That was a close one..."
Touya: "No way. We're in a hurry too,
so we'll go first."
Derock: "W-What a nasty guy.
You know I'm in a hurry, yet you get in my way.
You're the lowest of the low."
Yamato: "Sorry about that."
Derock: "Just get going!"
